backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only OHLCV known after the signal-date close; paper entry is the next available open with production entry slippage; exit is ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No core filter or live entry rule was added. The target source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / entry: near-high stocks with accelerating recent relative strength may add cleaner replacement alpha than static momentum screens.

2_history_check.exp-20260426-047_and_051: Pullback reclaim shadow was promising but failed production-path replay; this is not a reclaim pattern.
2_history_check.exp-20260429-002: Sector persistence failed under slot-aware replay; this does not use sector persistence.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-020_to_024: Volatility-contraction/VCP has accepted and rejected nearby work; this run avoids range-compression/VCP fields.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-037: OBV plus price breakout was a distinct accumulation source; this run tests recent RS acceleration instead.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: Stock-only relative-strength acceleration candidates may add default-off replacement alpha when recent 5-day excess versus SPY accelerates above the prior 15-day excess while 20-day relative strength, high-close quality, and liquidity stay strong.
interpretation: The RS acceleration sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or retry nearby RS5/RS20 acceleration thresholds on these frozen windows without forward paper rows or an orthogonal source-quality field.
next_evidence_needed: Forward replacement-value rows or an orthogonal free-data quality field; do not simply retune RS acceleration thresholds.

source_definition: stock ticker only; no ETF/proxy tickers
5-day return exceeds SPY by at least 2.5%
20-day return exceeds SPY by at least 4.0%
top-1 selected paper entry per signal date

prediction.confidence_reason: Meta research favors production-visible default-off paper adapters, but recent OHLCV candidate pools often overfit; this variant avoids VCP/reclaim and uses only a single RS-acceleration source.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would require a shared default-off paper adapter and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe joins remain sparse. Skipped 13F because the known audit shows no usable PIT rows. Skipped VCP/inside-day/reclaim and Companyfacts adjacent retunes because recent logs require forward rows or materially new fields. This uses one free-OHLCV RS-acceleration field.
